title: Nonhuman cognition: provenance, channel, agency, actual learning and clock separation
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full proposed cognition palette; retained mechanisms and qualified evidence
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full content review covers all seven knowledge profiles, MN-E1–MN-E8, MN-S1–MN-S32, MN1–MN18 and MN-P1–MN-P5. Keep knower/history, physical channel, practiced execution, action controller, emitted signal, delivered message, interpretation and social/legal response separate. A recipient can understand without speaking, receive content without reading its script, and remember a donor experience without having witnessed it. A clear interface intention does not grant in-world literacy or magic. Existing observation receipts are a bounded information subsystem, not proof of a general cognition, telepathy or scent adapter.

F2. Native expertise and actual granted knowledge may start strong without a compulsory ignorance or human-tutor phase. Animal/monster/object appearance does not set intelligence; missing touch or damaged articulation does not erase emotion, memory or personhood. Emerging awareness is not one universal core recipe; brood society is not intrinsically a hive mind. A genuinely single distributed knower and autonomous linked people have different knowledge ownership. Define actual transmission, disconnection and conflicting reports without forcing every sourced mind through ordinary limited-bandwidth biology. Exact sourced translation can work while truthfulness, privacy and recipient access remain separate operations.

F3. Instinct, learned association, selected source compulsion and controller takeover remain different causes. Preserve useful agency and supported mitigation without inventing automatic aggression, a universal obedience switch or mandatory disadvantage on declining a cue. Conversely a selected actual compulsion need not become cosmetic. Offline branching follows the funded/selected routine and actual decision boundary; it does not cancel settled work merely because a tempting trail appeared. Emotion cues and interspecies misunderstandings are authored opportunities, not universal animal science or species deficits.

F4. Memory provenance and event time survive later reinterpretation; a familiar trace alone is not present identity or location. Recurring recollection is not a world reset, accelerated thought is not extra physical queue payout, and subjective rhythm is not a hidden deadline extension. MN15/MN-P5 prevent fabricated discovery or duplicate lesson awards on unchanged input; they do not ban genuine repeated practice, improved skill or new evidence through an actual learning mechanism. Keep old/new beliefs, actual observations and another actor's unseen motives distinct. Cosmetic comfort or quiet play needs no automatic affection, legal-rights, XP or mood-meter reward.

F5. All eight evidence rows retain their dossier/speaker/secondary/translation and continuity limits: WN member IDs are not printed chapter numbers, a reported soul-less replica is not authenticated interior autobiography, and early guide behavior is not its permanent later agency model. The report does not freshly read those primary works. HP binding, Shadow interior continuity, FMA continuity-specific senses/memory, JJK compatibility and Paradise alias/soul gaps remain named. The one-realm/prestige sentence and 1366-primary presentation gate are superseded by current direction; use the current desktop prose-first/optional-art context and AD36/AD43 stages for a selected consumer. Under AD32 these remain proposals; AD42 keeps human review optional. No cognition implementation, source acquisition or runtime proof is added.
reviews.evidence: Entire 364-line input delivered in ranges 1–145,146–270,271–364. Source and book links are attributed report evidence, not fresh linked-content or runtime reads.
reviews.reopen: Selected cognition/communication consumer, changed mind/body/clock semantics or qualified source exception; no whole-cognition-engine launch implied.
